title: Your host recommends their cousin's driver
scenario: Your accommodation host warmly recommends their cousin as a private driver for the day, cash only, no app, saying it's cheaper and more reliable than booking one yourself.

answers.A: Book it since your host clearly trusts them.
answers.B: Book transport through a licensed app or your accommodation's official service instead.
answers.C: Book it, and pay the full day's fee upfront in cash.

explanation: A warm personal recommendation removes the pricing transparency, receipts, and accountability that an app-based or licensed service provides, even when the host means well.
proTip: Trusting your host doesn't require trusting an unlicensed driver with no receipt.
